title: When the Undertow Falls
author: Silas Vane
blurb: Hazel Vane, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
